data_fields.name: reveal_distance_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: longer axis plus half the shorter, integer

data_fields.name: unit_reveal_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: fogUncoverRadius per unit type (27 entries, values 0 to 5)

data_fields.name: structure_reveal_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: fogUncoverRadius per structure type (19 entries, values 1 to 10)

data_fields.name: radar_on_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: outpost built and powerProduction >= powerUsage (same test both ways, no dead band)

best_idea: Draw the minimap from the player's own reveal state only: tiles uncovered by a radius around their units and buildings (the radius as data), enemy units shown only on uncovered tiles while a radar building is powered, own buildings always, and redrawn only from a dirty queue.
decision_why: The reveal-disc rule, the radar gate and the dirty queue fit Frankendom's zone map and its HUD budget; the donor's shared-map view is rejected because Frankendom's server must filter per player.
acceptance: On a 375 px phone in a zone, the minimap shows terrain and enemy units only inside the discs uncovered by the player's units and buildings; with its radar building unpowered it shows only the player's own buildings. Server test: the snapshot sent to player A contains no tile or unit outside A's reveal, and a tile uncovered this tick is redrawn in the same tick.
